verdict.rationale: The only sandbox reference (monday-docs-5) describes isolated, monday-managed hosting infrastructure where deployed apps and syncs run. That is runtime isolation for production code, not a test environment with data kept separate from production. Version promotion (monday-docs-17) hints at a release workflow, but nothing documents a sandbox account, test workspace, or separation from production data, so the story's capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
